cases.description: A kind='venue' crawl target single-mapped to BeerDock Boa Viagem. Independent review of this fix (re-checking all 16 CASA FORTE events individually, not just a 3-event spot check) found 15 of them already carry venue_id='beerdock_casa_forte' -- a DIFFERENT, specific venue, correctly reattributed hours earlier by plans/260912_events-venue-night-duplication.md's own backfill (neighbourhood_match) -- and correctly excluded as non-corroborating evidence against the ORIGINAL mapping. The 16th CASA FORTE event (evt_01M1R2H85295C2CBPS1PZVJSJF) was NEVER reattributed -- it still carries venue_id=<BeerDock Boa Viagem itself>, linked_by=None -- so it is correctly still checkable and non-corroborating under the fix. Combined with one further real, distinct, genuinely still-unresolved event ('Mirante do Paco, Recife', also still own-venue), that is 2 real checkable non-corroborating events -- exactly meeting the pattern bar of 2. The handle therefore REMAINS flagged after the fix, with its non-corroborating count reduced from 17 (of the real 46) to 2 -- matching the real full-dataset production result (2/31) this fix was independently re-verified against. This is a representative subset (17 of the real 46), not the full set, sufficient to prove the fix without fabricating unfetched location_text values for the remaining ~29.
